• Type: Stem
  • Origin: North America
  • Growth rate: Medium
  • Height: 15 - 30+ cm
  • Light demand: Medium
  • CO2: Medium
Ludwigia glandulosa requires CO2 addition to grow well. The stems become 15-40 cm tall and 5-12 cm wide. The leaves turn greener and the lower ones may fall off if sufficient light is not provided.
Ludwigia glandulosa from North America is a very beautiful water plant. It used to be sold as Ludwigia perennis.
